latestVersion.changelog:
Initial launch of Free Video Generator Hugging Face — generate AI-powered videos from text prompts.

- Instantly create AI-generated 720p video from text or images using Hugging Face open-source models
- Automatic setup with free session/token handling (100 credits, 7-day expiry; anonymous mode supported)
- Simple command-based actions: generate, edit, upload, preview, export, check credits/status
- All-in-one cloud pipeline (1-3 min turnaround); supports formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, jpg, png, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac
- Clear session and error handling (auto-recover from expired token, no credits, or lost session)
- Timeline summary and conversational feedback on media and edits
